_meta.what: Hand-labeled samskara similarity probe set: 80 claim pairs sampled stratified across the centered claim-pair similarity range, each labeled into one of four classes.
_meta.sampled: 2026-09-05 from the prod corpus (104 survivor claims, post threshold-collapse; survivorship-biased toward low similarity - re-sample on rotation)
_meta.embedded_with: gte-small (384-dim, Supabase.ai.Session), padded to 2048 storage dims
_meta.scored_under: CLAIM-mean centering: both prediction vectors normalized, the mean of all 104 claim vectors subtracted, renormalized; sim = centered cosine. The claim-space bars (MINT_DEDUP_COSINE 0.50, collapse 0.30/0.40, tier-2 band [0.10, 0.35)) are solved on THIS scale. Centering claims with the substrate mean instead is a different scale - measured NN median 0.648 vs 0.404 here.
_meta.labeler: operator (Jeff), reading both claim texts per pair
_meta.labels: duplicate = same predictive claim, a rewording; same-topic = shared domain and strongly overlapping behavior, not interchangeable; related = shared theme/register, distinct behavior; unrelated = neither
_meta.on_rotation: re-embed the pair texts, re-center with the new claim mean, re-score, re-derive the bars (see docs/dev/samskara.md "Similarity calibration")
